en: \rViola: Let me take a picture to celebrate my victory!
\bGrant: Time to climb to the top by defeating you, \PN!
\bGrant: You've climbed so high already. Keep climbing!
\bGrant: Looks like I'm a lot closer to the top now!
\rKorrina: Time for Lady Korrina's grand appearance! Let's get things rolling!
\rKorrina: Lucario and I will win next time!
\rKorrina: Annnd it's Lady Korrina's grand victory!
\bRamos: I'll show ya that dem wizened trees can still blossom! Not that I'm old, mind yeh.
\bRamos: Still got the quickness of youth but the skill of a master, I see.
\bRamos: I may be past my prime, but I'm still in season!
\bClemont: The future is now, thanks to science! Get ready for a challenge, \PN.
\bClemont: That was a great battle! I'm looking forward to our next one.
\bClemont: That was definitely a futuristic battle!
\rValerie: The elusive Fairy may appear frail as the breeze and delicate as a bloom, but it is strong.
\rValerie: I hope that you will continue to find things worth smiling about tomorrow...
\rValerie: Oh goodness, what a pity... Even the most innocent looking Pokémon may hide tremendous strength.
\rOlympia: Thank you again for your efforts in saving Kalos, \PN. But now, we have an ancient custom deciding one's destiny. The battle begins!
\rOlympia: Continue to create your own path, \PN. Your future is bright!
\rOlympia: Winner and loser. A winged Pokémon leads on, to the goal of both.
\bWulfric: Come on, \PN. Let's battle - not for learning about learning from them or bonds - but because it's fun!
\bWulfric: Impressive! Your Pokémon fought with great courage.
\bWulfric: You know what, \PN? Your Pokémon really threw everything they had into that battle just now. You truly are something, you know?
\rMalva: I might've been a part of Team Flare before, but things are different now.
\rMalva: Hmph. If you want your dreams to come true, you have to be strong enough to force them to happen.
\rMalva: Ooh, I am delighted!
\bSiebold: I'm very much looking forward to a battle full of exceptional treats and battles.
\bSiebold: And yet, I shall store my memory of you and your Pokémon forever away within my heart.
\bSiebold: Our battle was like food for my soul. It shall keep me going. That is how I will pay my respects to you for giving your all in battle!
\bWikstrom: Verily am I the famed blade of hardened steel!
\bWikstrom: Glorious! The trust that you share with your honorable Pokémon surpasses even mine!
\bWikstrom: Winning against such a worthy opponent doth give my soul wings - thus do I soar!
\rDrasna: Oh, goodness, it's \PN! How lovely to see you here. This is my chance to have my revenge!
\rDrasna: Oh, you and your Pokémon are simply charming!
\rDrasna: Oh my, how can this be? I'm glad I was finally able to get my revenge.
\rShauna: I may be a Pokémon Performer, but I can still battle!
\rShauna: I suppose I need more battling experience.
\rShauna: My experiences have paid off!
\bTierno: Wanna see my improved dance moves, \PN?
\bTierno: Our dance moves couldn't stop you again!
\bTierno: How'd you like our dance moves?
\bTrevor: This is gonna be a great photo op!
\bTrevor: I got some nice photos, but they were for your Pokémon!
\bTrevor: I got some nice photos of my Pokémon!
\rSerena: Hey \PN! I'm glad we get to battle here. Let me show you what I've learnt in Hoenn!
\rSerena: I'm glad I was able to give it my all!
\rSerena: Hehe, I won! See you around, \PN.
\bSycamore: How is your Pokémon journey going, \PN? Show me what you've learnt.
\bSycamore: Looks like you've been doing well! Keep going, \PN.
\bSycamore: I'm tougher than I look, you know.
\bIlima: Greetings, \PN! I have been looking forward to facing Alola's first champion.
\bIlima: What an incredible trainer you are!
\bIlima: I see. Unfortunately, this is where it ends for you.
\rLana: Hey \PN! I'm gonna reel you in with my skills!
\rLana: I got reeled in instead!
\rLana: We reeled you in!
\bKiawe: Finally, we get to battle each other on the world stage, \PN. I'll show you how much I've improved!
\bKiawe: Looks like I need to get in some extra training. Win this for me \PN, alright?
\bKiawe: My training paid off!
\rMallow: Hi \PN! Let me serve you up with a plate of my new improved Super Mallow Special!
\rMallow: Hmm... I think we needed more flavor in that. I'll keep improving the recipe for next time!
\rMallow: How'd you like that dish? Pretty flavorful, right?
\bSophocles: Oh, hi \PN! Wanna see my cool gadgets in this battle?
\bSophocles: Oh well. I guess there's next time.
\bSophocles: My gadgets were pretty cool, right?
\rMina: Heyyy, you and your Pokémon would make a real pretty painting. I'll sketch your composition in this battle!
\rMina: At least I got your victory pose. Wanna see it?
\rMina: Hehe, I got to sketch your loser's pose. Wanna see it?
\rAcerola: Heya \PN! I know you've grown a lot stronger since taking on Tapu Bulu. But I'm still gonna try and beat you!
\rAcerola: Hehe, that training really paid off, huh?
\rAcerola: Hehe, not good enough! Did that give you a fright?
\bHapu: I may be the newest Island Kahuna, but that doesn't mean I'm the weakest!
\bHapu: I'll have to continue training harder so that I won't be outdone next time!
\bHapu: I may be young, but don't underestimate me!
\bNanu: Yawn... Well, if it isn't \PN. Let's make this quick.
\bNanu: See ya later.
\bNanu: Great, now I have to continue with this tournament.
\rOlivia: My my, it's \PN. How much more polished are you now?
\rOlivia: You're certainly much more polished than you were before.
\rOlivia: You're certainly more polished than you were before, but you could use more polishing.
\rKahili: Let the winds of victory blow for the better trainer.
